// HUNT-RACE repro R-2: #3711 wb_ oscillation at main 3fc3a1458.
// A work item in state "working" whose item claim lease has expired maps to
// a board row in_progress carrying the EXPIRED leaseExpiresAt. The board's
// own lease sweep releases that row (unclaimed + lease_expired stamp); the
// next board sync/backfill re-maps it to in_progress (a swept row is not
// "diverged" per isDiverged), and the sweep releases it again — forever.
// Pure-function harness over the real modules. Run: node repro-wb-oscillation.mjs
import { boardClaimForWorkItem, planWorkItemBoardBackfill, boardClaimId } from "__R1ROOT__/server/work-item-board.mjs";
import { releaseExpired } from "__R1ROOT__/server/work-claims.mjs";

const T = Date.parse("2026-10-18T12:00:00.000Z");
const H = 3600 * 1000;
const iso = ms => new Date(ms).toISOString();
let failures = 0;
const expect = (cond, label) => { console.log(`${cond ? "PASS" : "FAIL"}  ${label}`); if (!cond) failures += 1; };

// Work item: working, claim acquired 3h ago, lease expired 1h ago.
// The item layer has no expiry transition of its own — it stays "working".
const item = {
  id: "wi-1", title: "Projected task", state: "working",
  accountableMemberId: "agent-a",
  claim: { status: "active", holderId: "agent-a", acquiredAt: iso(T - 3 * H), expiresAt: iso(T - H) },
  labels: [], updatedAt: iso(T - H),
};

// Step 1: projection maps the row.
const mapped = boardClaimForWorkItem(item, null, { nowMs: T });
console.log(`      mapped row: state=${mapped.state} owner=${mapped.owner} leaseExpiresAt=${mapped.leaseExpiresAt}`);
expect(mapped.state === "in_progress", "projection: working item with expired claim lease maps to in_progress");
expect(mapped.leaseExpiresAt === iso(T - H), "projection: row carries the EXPIRED lease timestamp");

// Step 2: the board lease sweep (sweepRoom / sweepExpiredClaimLeases both
// feed stored rows through releaseExpired) releases the projected row.
const [swept] = releaseExpired([mapped], T);
console.log(`      after sweep: state=${swept.state} owner=${swept.owner} last stamp=${swept.history.at(-1)?.action}`);
expect(swept.state === "unclaimed" && swept.owner === null, "sweep: projected row released to unclaimed");
expect(swept.history.some(entry => entry.action === "lease_expired"), "sweep: lease_expired stamp appended (wakes/flake fire in the real paths)");

// Step 3: the next sync/backfill re-plans with the swept row as existing.
const plan = planWorkItemBoardBackfill({ items: [item], events: [], existing: new Map([[mapped.id, swept]]), nowMs: T });
const remapped = plan.rows.get(boardClaimId("wi-1"));
console.log(`      re-plan: diverged=${JSON.stringify(plan.diverged)} remapped state=${remapped?.state}`);
expect(plan.diverged.length === 0, "re-plan: swept row is NOT classified diverged (isDiverged only flags foreign-owned active / terminal rows)");
expect(remapped && remapped.state === "in_progress", "re-plan: row restored to in_progress — oscillation loop closed");

// Step 4: second sweep releases it again — the loop is stable, not one-off.
const [swept2] = releaseExpired([remapped], T);
expect(swept2.state === "unclaimed", "cycle 2: sweep releases the restored row again");

console.log(failures ? `\nRESULT: ${failures} expectation(s) failed` : "\nRESULT: oscillation reproduced — sweep and projection disagree forever about wb_ rows with expired item leases");
process.exit(failures ? 1 : 0);
